{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import Control.Concurrent
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Concurrent.STM
import Control.Concurrent.STM.TVar
import Control.Exception
import Control.Monad (forM_, when, forever, void)
import Data.IORef
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import System.Posix.Signals
import System.IO
import System.Exit
import Data.Time.Clock

type ContainerId = String
type ConnHandle = Int

data PoolState = PoolState
  { activeConns   :: Map.Map ContainerId ConnHandle
  , pendingDrain  :: Bool
  , connCounter   :: Int
  , shutdownFlag  :: Bool
  } deriving (Show)

data OrchestratorState = OrchestratorState
  { pool          :: TVar PoolState
  , drainLock     :: MVar ()
  , workerThreads :: TVar [ThreadId]
  , cleanupDone   :: MVar Bool
  }

initState :: IO OrchestratorState
initState = do
  p <- newTVarIO (PoolState Map.empty False 0 False)
  dl <- newMVar ()
  wt <- newTVarIO []
  cd <- newEmptyMVar
  return $ OrchestratorState p dl wt cd

acquireConnection :: OrchestratorState -> ContainerId -> IO (Maybe ConnHandle)
acquireConnection orch cid = do
  result <- atomically $ do
    st <- readTVar (pool orch)
    if shutdownFlag st
      then return Nothing
      else do
        let newCounter = connCounter st + 1
            newConns = Map.insert cid newCounter (activeConns st)
        writeTVar (pool orch) st { activeConns = newConns, connCounter = newCounter }
        return (Just newCounter)
  threadDelay 1000
  return result

releaseConnection :: OrchestratorState -> ContainerId -> IO ()
releaseConnection orch cid = atomically $ do
  st <- readTVar (pool orch)
  let newConns = Map.delete cid (activeConns st)
  writeTVar (pool orch) st { activeConns = newConns }

drainPool :: OrchestratorState -> IO ()
drainPool orch = do
  conns <- atomically $ do
    st <- readTVar (pool orch)
    writeTVar (pool orch) st { pendingDrain = True }
    return (activeConns st)
  forM_ (Map.keys conns) $ \cid -> do
    threadDelay 500
    releaseConnection orch cid
  atomically $ do
    st <- readTVar (pool orch)
    writeTVar (pool orch) st { pendingDrain = False, shutdownFlag = True }

gracefulShutdown :: OrchestratorState -> IO ()
gracefulShutdown orch = do
  acquired <- tryTakeMVar (drainLock orch)
  case acquired of
    Nothing -> return ()
    Just _  -> do
      drainPool orch
      threads <- atomically $ readTVar (workerThreads orch)
      forM_ threads $ \tid -> killThread tid
      putMVar (cleanupDone orch) True

installSignalHandlers :: OrchestratorState -> IO ()
installSignalHandlers orch = do
  let handler = Catch $ do
        void $ forkIO (gracefulShutdown orch)
  installHandler sigTERM handler Nothing
  installHandler sigINT handler Nothing
  return ()

workerLoop :: OrchestratorState -> ContainerId -> IO ()
workerLoop orch cid = forever $ do
  mconn <- acquireConnection orch cid
  case mconn of
    Nothing -> threadDelay 100000
    Just h  -> do
      threadDelay 50000
      releaseConnection orch cid
      threadDelay 10000

spawnWorker :: OrchestratorState -> ContainerId -> IO ()
spawnWorker orch cid = do
  tid <- forkIO $ workerLoop orch cid
  atomically $ modifyTVar' (workerThreads orch) (tid:)

main :: IO ()
main = do
  orch <- initState
  installSignalHandlers orch
  let containers = ["web-" ++ show i | i <- [1..5]]
  forM_ containers (spawnWorker orch)
  hPutStrLn stderr "Orchestrator running, send SIGTERM to shutdown"
  result <- takeMVar (cleanupDone orch)
  when result $ hPutStrLn stderr "Clean shutdown complete"
  exitSuccess
